plain: Three privacy attitudes, very privacy-minded, pragmatic and unconcerned, used to label which facts are fine to share.
eli5: Asking a worried friend, a sensible friend and a carefree friend, and only trusting the answer when they all agree.
technical: The privacy fundamentalist, pragmatist and unconcerned segments from Alan Westin's consumer surveys (as summarised by Kumaraguru and Cranor 2005), which CIMemories' labeller role-plays; distinct from Westin's definition of privacy as individual control over one's information, which contextual integrity argues against.
